description: CalEITC 2025 v2 STEEP phase-out segment (3+ kids, anchored to the printed table row 9,951-10,000 -> $3,699, midpoint $9,975.50): earned $16,500 falls in bracket 16,451-16,500 (true midpoint $16,475.50). credit = round($3,699 - 38.25% x ($16,475.50 - $9,975.50)) = round($3,699 - 38.25% x $6,500) = round($3,699 - $2,486.25) = $1,213 (rounding the exact-cents intermediate 121,275 cents to the nearest dollar rounds up). Matches the printed FTB 3514 row 16,451-16,500 -> 1,213 (3+ kids column) exactly.
